purpose: Verify Gustafta private-surface concealment and account isolation on real BFCache Back/Forward restorations.

testSetup.accounts: Two fresh synthetic Clerk accounts in one shared browser context
testSetup.accountSwitch: While A was frozen, the sibling tab changed to B using the Clerk helper redirect to /api/me; the sibling did not mount the Gustafta app or its BroadcastChannel publisher.
testSetup.privateFixture: Two independent runs, each with two fresh synthetic accounts and one new A-owned case: the detail/Forward-failure run and the dashboard-summary continuation. All identifying values omitted.

trustedLifecycleObservations.method: Native browser history traversal; no pageshow/pagehide events were dispatched or network requests intercepted.

afterGuardReload.observedResult: B identity shown; A detail reports that the case cannot be found or loaded.

forward.observedResult: The production app displayed the session-verification error for GET /api/me · HTTP 503 and stated private data remains closed; the A marker was absent.

accountIsolation.siblingApiOnlyBSession: Verified /api/me profile and stored identity matched B; no app shell was mounted in the sibling.
accountIsolation.ADataUnderB: Not visible after the persisted Back restore and fresh B identity check.
accountIsolation.AOwnedCaseUnderB: Denied by the UI with the case-not-found/load state; no A marker appeared.

dashboardSummaryContinuation.scope: A-owned /dashboard summary only; the previously passing detail and API-503 failure cases were not repeated.
dashboardSummaryContinuation.productionBuildCommand: PORT=26110 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/gustafta-sbu run build

pagehide.observationPhase: Early capture listener before the app's pagehide conceal handler; this record is not the post-handler saved frame.

freshMeAndDashboard.observedOrder: The fresh /api/me response was awaited and its B identity checked before waiting for the sidebar locator; that locator then resolved with B's sidebar and no A marker.
freshMeAndDashboard.timestampGap: The dashboard-shell observer did not emit a first-shell timestamp in this run; the response-before-sidebar order was captured by the response waiter followed by the awaited sidebar locator.

failureFixture.method: Temporary opt-in API-server-only fixture returned HTTP 503 for GET /api/me while the production frontend remained online.
failureFixture.result: The Forward restore reloaded the production app and rendered the closed identity-verification state.
failureFixture.cleanup: Fixture code and env override removed; API Server restarted normally.

offlineAttempt.observed: A separate offline Forward produced Chromium ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED on the top-level reload, not the app error component.
offlineAttempt.interpretation: Not counted as the in-app failure verification; the online API 503 fixture supplied that verification.

workflow.apiServer: Temporary fixture removed; restarted without test env override.
workflow.gustaftaWeb: Original Vite dev script restored and web workflow restarted.

verificationGaps: Firefox and WebKit were not exercised.

The dashboard follow-up's first B-shell timestamp was not emitted by the original observer. The real ordering was still verified by awaiting the fresh /api/me 200/B response before the B sidebar locator resolved; the runner now includes a reset-on-document-start observer with a polling fallback.
The request/response ordering was verified through the fresh /api/me result, rendered account/error state, and the VerifiedRoutes gate; no network interception was used.
